findings.subject: card
findings.summary: Card variant="interactive"/"overlay" makes a <div> look clickable (cursor:pointer, hover lift) with no focus-visible design, and the shipped examples (Compositions, CursorLabel) are pointer-only interactive cards with no link or button, so builders copying them ship cards keyboard users cannot reach.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/card/card.css:68-85 (no .a63-Card:focus-visible rule; only .a63-CardLink:focus-visible at 343); packages/ui-react/src/components/card/card.stories.tsx:173, 204, 270-290 (div cards, CursorLabel 'External link affordance' has no anchor); `pnpm -s atom63 example card` serves these stories as known-good; card.json crossRenderer outcome 'Interactive card has one primary action'.
findings.fix: Make the interactive and overlay stories render the card as a link (render={<a href>} or CardLink) with one primary action; add a .a63-Card:focus-visible outline (and :has(> a:focus-visible) for the stretched-link pattern); state in the docs guidance that interactive requires a link/button render; add a story test asserting interactive cards expose a focusable link or button.

findings.subject: card
findings.summary: Card's contract requires a focus-visible state, but no recipe rule styles it and no baseline captures it.
findings.evidence: card.json crossRenderer.requiredStates [rest, interactive, focus-visible]; packages/ui-react/src/components/card/card.css has no focus-visible selector for .a63-Card; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-card-*.png has no focus state.
findings.fix: Add the focus-visible style (see the K2 finding) and a focused baseline for the interactive card.

findings.subject: card
findings.summary: The cursor label paints --a63-text-primary as a fill and --a63-surface-page as text (token-role debt recorded in craft-baseline.json).
findings.fix: Introduce or reuse an inverse surface/foreground pair (as tooltip-style surfaces need) and drop the baseline entries.

findings.subject: card
findings.summary: Card hover lift and media zoom are not gated by @media (hover: hover), so a tap on touch leaves the card lifted.
findings.fix: Wrap the :hover rules in @media (hover: hover).

findings.subject: item
findings.summary: ItemSeparator is announced as a separator although the item contract promises dividers hidden from assistive technology, and ItemGroup carries no list semantics.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/item/item.tsx:55-63 (Separator without decorative); separator.tsx:28; item.json accessibilityOutcomes 'hides-dividers-from-assistive-technology'; item.tsx:43 ItemGroup is a bare div.
findings.fix: Default ItemSeparator to decorative; give ItemGroup role="list" and Item role="listitem" by default (overridable), as shadcn does, and add a test.

findings.subject: item
findings.summary: ItemTitle and ItemDescription declare line clamps that never apply, because neither sets display:-webkit-box; long titles and descriptions wrap without limit.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/item/item.css:236-261 (ItemTitle display:flex at 237 with -webkit-line-clamp:1; ItemDescription -webkit-line-clamp:2 with no display).
findings.fix: Clamp on an inner span or switch the elements to display:-webkit-box (keeping the title's icon gap via an inline wrapper); add a long-string story/baseline.

findings.subject: item
findings.summary: Item hover on rendered links is not gated by (hover: hover), leaving a sticky fill after a tap.
findings.fix: Gate the :hover rules with @media (hover: hover).

findings.subject: frame
findings.summary: FrameTitle is a plain div, so a frame's title is neither a heading nor the frame's accessible name.
findings.fix: Let FrameTitle render a heading level via render/as, or wire aria-labelledby from Frame to FrameTitle.

findings.subject: frame
findings.summary: The inner panel radius falls back to --radius-2xl instead of --a63-frame-radius, so overriding the frame radius breaks concentric corners.
findings.fix: Use calc(var(--a63-surface-radius, var(--a63-frame-radius)) - var(--a63-frame-pad)).

findings.subject: frame

findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 component frame` Usage and Guidance sections.
findings.fix: Add a usage example and one guidance line on variant vs tray/panel/border.

findings.subject: separator
findings.summary: Separators (and the resizable handle and item inset dividers) are drawn only with background-color and vanish in forced-colors mode; no component in this batch has a forced-colors rule.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/separator/separator.css:10,27-44; packages/ui-react/src/components/resizable/resizable.css:25; packages/ui-react/src/components/item/item.css:69-76; grep 'forced-colors' over the 10 component folders: no hits.
findings.fix: Add @media (forced-colors: active) { background-color: CanvasText } (or draw the rule with a border) for separator, resizable handle and inset dividers.

findings.subject: separator

findings.fix: Accept mode="decorative"|"semantic" (keep decorative as a deprecated alias) or drop modes from the contract.

findings.subject: scroll-area
findings.summary: The scrollFade mask fades the wrong edges in right-to-left layouts: it maps the logical x-start/x-end overflow to physical right/left gradients.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/scroll-area/scroll-area.css:52-60; Base UI computes start/end logically (node_modules/@base-ui/react/scroll-area/viewport/ScrollAreaViewport.js:141-147); apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-scrollablelist-right-to-left-chromium-linux.png (start edge faded, hidden end edge hard-cut).
findings.fix: Swap the two horizontal gradients under :dir(rtl) (or wrap with Base UI's DirectionProvider and mirror); baseline an RTL ScrollArea with scrollFade.

findings.subject: scrollable-list
findings.summary: ScrollableList's default edge mask fades the wrong edge in RTL (same root cause as the ScrollArea mask), visible in its own RTL baseline.
findings.fix: Fixed by the scroll-area RTL mask fix; re-baseline RightToLeft.

findings.subject: scrollable-list
findings.summary: With draggable on, ScrollableList captures the pointer on every pointerdown before any movement, which can retarget the following click to the viewport so list items never get clicked (needs a browser check); the prop also shadows HTML draggable.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/scrollable-list/scrollable-list.tsx:164-171 (setPointerCapture in onPointerDown), 37 (draggable prop); no test clicks an item in a draggable list.
findings.fix: Capture only after the 3px movement threshold (in onPointerMove); add a browser test that clicking a button inside a draggable list fires it; consider renaming to dragToScroll.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel exposes a `variant` axis ('button-group' | 'default') that its contract does not list.
findings.fix: Add variants [default, button-group] to connected-panel.json, generate the type, and import it instead of the local union.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel widths are px numbers (192/320, content calc(320px - 2px)), so they ignore text scaling and density.
findings.fix: Default to rem or token-based widths and derive content width from the panel (100%) instead of a fixed calc.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: In a container narrower than expandedWidth the panel shrinks to max-width:100% but its content keeps a fixed calc(320px - 2px) width and is clipped.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.css:14 (max-width:100%) vs connected-panel.tsx:331-338 (fixed content width) and css:334-338 (overflow:hidden).
findings.fix: Size the content clip with min(contentWidth, 100%) and add a 320px phone-width story.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel content scales from a physical corner (top left/top right), so in RTL the start-aligned panel grows from the wrong corner.
findings.fix: Swap the origins under :dir(rtl) or compute from align + direction.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: The ConnectedPanel trigger's aria-controls points at a content id that is unmounted while closed (default forceMount=false).
findings.fix: Set aria-controls only while the content is mounted, as Accordion does.
